what: Addendum U: what shipped parsers do to every raw model output this project has banked. Reference = the shipped fencecheck strip_fence + fail-closed parse_json_object. Readings applied by arithmetic from docs/research/ADDENDUM_U_PROTOCOL.md.
preregistration: docs/research/ADDENDUM_U_PROTOCOL.md (committed 7e0cf36 before the runner was written)

parsers.strict: json.loads(text); except ValueError -> None; non-object -> None (evals/elsuite/basic/json_match.py:80 semantics, verbatim)
parsers.autoevals_validjson: autoevals.ValidJSON().valid_json(text) == 1 gate, then json.loads (autoevals/json.py:162-163, the gate JSONDiff uses)
parsers.fencecheck (reference): tools/fencecheck.strip_fence + arcttt.scoring.parse_json_object; zero loss by construction, not ranked

readings.U1: U1 EXCEPTION IN granite, smollm2: named at full size; the sentence becomes 'on N of the 4 families tested' -- never 'across families'. LOSES fired in only 2 of 4 families, so there is NO combined headline in either form: the rates publish and nothing is said about families as a class. Per-family: {"falcon3": "LOSES", "granite": "DOES NOT LOSE", "qwen2.5": "LOSES", "smollm2": "DOES NOT LOSE"}

U2.langchain_parse_json_markdown: U2 MATERIAL: hazard >= 0.05 on 6 slice(s) with n >= 30; worst smollm2|1.7B|prompted|cord|schema|k=0|greedy at 0.1500. Lenient repair changes or invents content on real outputs.
U2.json_repair: U2 MATERIAL: hazard >= 0.05 on 8 slice(s) with n >= 30; worst falcon3|1B|prompted|cord|schema|k=0|greedy at 0.1900. Lenient repair changes or invents content on real outputs.

readings.U3: U3 SAME PHENOMENON: strict loses 0.0000 of k=20 ref outputs (n_ref=1171) -- where the fence goes, the parser loss goes.

u2_substance_added_2026-09-04.why: added after the first run, before the row was written, and CORRECTED the same day: the first version labelled leading-fenced-but-malformed bodies as 'a fence after prose' (the reference's undercount). They are not: the reference stripped that fence and the body failed the fail-closed parse because it was truncated or held expressions. Only `exact_object_present` is recovery; the rest are repairs whose correctness is not adjudicated. The frozen readings above are untouched.

lenient_non_object_returns_added_2026-09.why: the protocol preregistered non-dict -> None for the lenient parsers; the shipped callables return lists (several objects found) and empty strings (nothing found) that a shipped consumer would receive. Counts banked, and the U2 slice table recomputed as if every list return counted as an object (an empty string is a failure any consumer would notice), so the reader can see what the preregistered rule hid.
